newsitem.title: GERMANY: German DAX steady near late Monday level at start.
newsitem.headline: German DAX steady near late Monday level at start.

text.p: German shares were steady near the levels reached after the market moved strongly higher in late Monday trading, but with no clear impetus for further gains today despite the steadily climbing dollar.
The 30-share DAX index was trading up 25.36 points at 3,338.24 at 0802 GMT, slightly below the 3,342.77 level notched up in IBIS computer-based trading on Monday evening.
But traders were generally positive on the outlook for the market, seeing the DAX now in a trading range of 3,320 to 3,390, with more scope for gains on the upside.
Among stocks in the news, Commerzbank gained 85 pfennigs to 46.95 marks after sounding a positive note on its outlook for 1997, predicting a further rise in profits.
